state:
- Eligibility gates do not establish the claimed dependencies: substantial de novo UTP synthesis or uridine rescue does not demonstrate inadequate compensatory salvage, and etomoxir-sensitive respiration is not FAO-specific. Measure salvage under physiological pyrimidine availability and validate FAO with orthogonal genetic and flux assays.
- Genotype-confirmed markers and morphology cannot fully distinguish induced differentiation from selective survival of pre-existing mature leukemic cells. Add longitudinal fate tracking and absolute counts of mature and immature genotype-positive populations.
- Novelty remains unsubstantiated pending the proposed search. Compare existing atovaquone–AML and respiratory-chain–DHODH studies, identifying whether the residual-state mechanism and stratification—not merely the drug choice—are new.
